messages:
Alex R.: quick ask — before I open a PR: can someone run a focused perf+quality smoke for int4 on the llama-2-13b variant with fp8 fallback? I want latency numbers + a quick BLEU-ish quality check on our internal eval set. target: <10% quality delta, latency < 1.2x baseline.
Mira S.: I can run it in the cluster today. which config? full seq len 2048 or 512?
Alex R.: 512 is fine for the smoke. use batch=8 and the usual kv-cache enabled. please try two runs: quant=int4 (symmetric) and quant=int4 with fp8-fallback for attention kernels.
Sam K.: pinging @Devon for the profiling artifacts — can you attach perf flamegraphs for the two runs? also want GPU util and kernel breakdown.
Devon (ci-bot): scheduled perf job: job/quant-smoke-1801234567 queued on node cuda-rt-5. ETA ~25m. will post artifacts to CI when done.
Jordan P.: small note: in prior sweeps fp8 reduced CPU-to-GPU memcpy overhead for attention layout X. watch for any memcpy spikes.
Mira S.: running now. command i'm using:
```bash
./run_bench --model llama-2-13b --seq 512 --batch 8 \
  --quant int4 --kv-cache on --profile flame --out artifacts/int4/
```
then repeat with `--quant int4+fp8-attn` and out to artifacts/int4_fp8/
Sam K.: thanks. for quality, run the small eval harness: `tools/eval/run_eval.py --subset smoke50 --out results.json` and paste the top-line metrics. no need for full eval.
Mira S.: noted. will include a quick diff of perplexity and our redwood-quality-score.
Alex R.: if you see >10% drop in the redwood-score, abort and tag me + @Priya. we might need to adjust clip scale in quantizer.
Priya: FYI I pushed a tiny tweak to the quant config (scale clipping to 2.5) in branch quant/clip-2.5, could affect outputs slightly. if Mira uses default she should mention it.
Mira S.: CI job finished: artifacts uploaded. summary: int4-only latency = 1.18x baseline, int4+fp8-attn = 1.06x baseline. GPU utilization for int4-only had 85% avg, int4+fp8 jumped to 92%.
Mira S.: quality smoke: baseline redwood-score=0.88, int4-only=0.79 (-10.2%), int4+fp8=0.81 (-8.0%). perplexity delta ~ +6% (int4-only) / +4% (int4+fp8). attaching artifacts: CI link: https://ci.internal/jobs/1801234567/artifacts
Sam K.: ok int4-only hits our hard threshold (just over 10%). int4+fp8 looks acceptable but still close. can we try clip-2.5 branch to see if that recovers a couple points?
Priya: happy to run clip-2.5 quick test — will spin a smoke with same params, only int4+fp8-attn.
Devon (ci-bot): scheduled perf job: job/quant-smoke-1801234578 queued on node cuda-rt-6. ETA ~20m.
Jordan P.: also add a run with `--kv-split 2` in case the KV layout affects the fp8 kernels; previous flaky cases surfaced there.
Priya: got it. running three variants: base int4+fp8, clip-2.5, and kv-split=2. will post numbers when done.
Mira S.: quick note on artifacts: flamegraphs show attention kernels dominate for int4-only (55% of token-time). fp8 run shifts some time into matmul kernels but reduces global mem stalls.
Sam K.: thanks — that pattern matches the hypothesis. next steps if clip recovers quality: we can land int4+fp8 with clip and enable fallback policy for hot routes.
Alex R.: timeline: if clip-2.5 recovers quality to within 7% delta and latency ~1.06x, i'm fine to promote to canary. otherwise keep as experimental. please tag this thread when PR is up: refs: https://repo.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls
Priya: quick numbers: clip-2.5 run finished: redwood-score=0.85 (-3.4%), latency 1.07x, gpu util 91%. kv-split=2 didn't help quality much but slightly lowered max memory. artifacts: https://ci.internal/jobs/1801234589/artifacts
Sam K.: great — clip-2.5 is a win. can someone open PR with the quant config + release note? I'll review.
Mira S.: i'll open the PR, include bench table and flamegraphs. PR will reference job ids 1801234567 & 1801234589.
Jordan P.: small request for the PR: add a note about fallback policy and perf regression guard (auto rollback at >12% quality drop).
Alex R.: perfect. thanks everyone. :rocket:
Priya: tagging followups — will run a slightly larger eval tomorrow (seq=1024) before canary.
Devon (ci-bot): CI: build passed for pr/quant-clip-2.5 (mergeable).
